Power Plant Emissions

Emissions from Power Generation Facilities

Air pollution caused by emissions from coal-fired power plants and other fossil-fueled electricity generation facilities, including long-range transport of pollutants from these sources.

Industrial Emissions

Emissions from Industrial and Manufacturing Facilities

Air pollution resulting from emissions by factories, manufacturing plants, refineries, petrochemical industries, and mining operations.

Transportation Emissions

Emissions from Transportation Sources

Air pollution caused by exhaust and emissions from vehicles such as cars, trucks, buses, motorcycles, as well as ships and planes. May include road dust resuspension due to traffic.

Biomass & Agriculture

Biomass Burning and Agricultural Emissions

Air pollution caused by burning of biomass for land clearing, slash-and-burn agriculture, deforestation, and wildfires, as well as emissions from agricultural activities.

Household Emissions

Emissions from Household Energy Use

Air pollution caused by household use of fossil fuels or biomass for cooking and heating, especially in under-resourced or rural settings.

Waste Burning

Emissions from Open Waste Burning

Air pollution resulting from the open burning of waste, including municipal solid waste, landfill fires, and neighborhood trash burning. Only applies when combustion is explicitly mentioned.

Construction & Dust

Construction Activities and Dust Resuspension

Air pollution caused by construction activities, roadworks, and resuspended soil or dust, especially in urban settings.
